svg.title: 02 · Detailed Application and Microservices Architecture
svg.desc: Participants call the FSPIOP API layer. API services publish to Kafka; handler processes consume, update MySQL and publish onward; the notification handler calls FSPs back. Account lookup uses HTTP only. Admin, settlement, observability, IAM, reporting and configuration domains are shown with their actual status.

Here central-ledger runs its API and most handlers in one process. docker-compose-perf.yml and the Kubernetes
deployment (moja-centralledger-handler-*) run each handler as its own scalable deployment.
